text:
Maya Rivera: Quick alignment on Vela Health onboarding — running a compact "first 90d" plan focused on search + chat integration and early retention metrics. Need: stakeholder owners, concrete success criteria, and obvious renewal-risk flags.

Jordan Li: +1. Can we lock scope to 2 teams for pilot to keep infra predictable?

Priya Nair: Agreed. I'll own enablement (training docs + 1:1s). Tentative schedule for enablement week: week of May 6. Link to draft deck: https://tiny.redwood/onboard-deck (will update).

Sam Brooks: I'll lead implementation and infra. Immediate blockers: SSO cert and data schema mapping. If those slip >2 weeks, timeline stretches.

Alex Chen: From Vela side — Alex (TPM). We'll provide sample data + API contract by next Tue. I'll be main stakeholder for go/no-go.

OnboardingBot: New checklist created: `vela-first90-checklist` — items: API keys, SSO, pilot users, eval set. Due dates auto-generated.

Jordan Li: Proposed success criteria (high level):
```
- Pilot adoption: 2 teams, 80% of pilot queries supported by model
- Latency: p95 < 600ms for search endpoints
- Cost: token spend within agreed budget +/-10%
- Quality: NPS of pilot users >= 7/10 on relevance after 30 days
- Privacy: no PII stored in logs (verified by audit)
```

Priya Nair: Add enablement criteria: all CS reps complete the quick lab and one shadow session. I'll track completion in the enablement sheet.

Sam Brooks: Risk matrix (quick):
- SSO delays -> blocks pilot onboarding
- Data mapping mismatch -> inaccurate search relevancy
- Model regression after quantization -> quality drop
- Network egress policy in prod VPC -> provisioning delay

Maya Rivera: Good list. For renewal-risk signals, flag if after 60 days: low engagement (avg queries/team < 10/day), failed SLA for latency, or unresolved data/sso > 21 days.

Alex Chen: Understood. We'll aim to assign a backup TPM in case of PTO. Also want a checklist for security review — can we get a point contact?

Priya Nair: Security review point: Priya + Sam will coordinate; Sam to send RequiredDocs by EOD.

Sam Brooks: Sending docs now. cc @Jordan for infra notes.

Jordan Li: I'll validate perf profiles and propose batching + quantization settings after pilot telemetry (target within 2 sprints).

Maya Rivera: Next steps (action items):
- Alex: sample data + API contract by Tue (Alex)
- Sam: SSO cert + RequiredDocs by EOD (Sam)
- Priya: Lock enablement week + deck updates (Priya)
- Jordan: Perf plan draft after initial telemetry (Jordan)
- Maya: run success-risk tracker and schedule 30/60/90 checkpoints (Maya)

Maya Rivera: Can everyone confirm they’re aligned and ok with EOD for confirmations? :raised_hands:

Alex Chen: Confirmed. :thumbsup:

Jordan Li: Confirmed. Will post perf template by Wed. :eyes:

Priya Nair: Confirmed. Updating enablement doc now.

Sam Brooks: Confirmed. Uploading cert files to secure bucket.

Maya Rivera: Great — I'll create calendar invites for the 30/60/90 check-ins and share the tracker. If any red flags pop up, ping #incidents and me directly. Thanks everyone.
